Dear [Mr Craik](/person/379)
I am afraid the last 3d of the [Primer](/book/353) is lost. I will re write it after my outing. Happily it is only 40 pp at most - I hope waiting will not be troublesome. Here is another instalment of '[The Story of the Christians and Moors in Spain](/book/126)'

Yours truly

C M Yonge
